SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PRODUCT_ID) AS total_products, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PRODUCT_ID) AS product_count, COALESCE(SUM(pc.TOTAL_COST), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(AVG(pc.UNIT_COST), 0) AS avg_unit_cost, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(pc.VARIANCE_RATE), 2), 0) AS cost_variance, COALESCE(SUM(pc.DIRECT_MATERIAL), 0) AS total_direct_material, COALESCE(SUM(pc.DIRECT_LABOR), 0) AS total_direct_labor, COALESCE(SUM(pc.MANUFACTURING_OVERHEAD), 0) AS total_manufacturing_overhead, COUNT(*) AS costing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pc.COSTING_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costing_in_progress, SUM(CASE WHEN pc.COSTING_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costing_completed FROM T_PRODUCT_COST pc WHERE pc.IS_DELETED = 0 AND pc.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND pc.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId}
AND pc.COSTING_PERIOD = #{param.costingPeriod}

SELECT pc.COSTING_PERIOD AS period, COALESCE(SUM(pc.TOTAL_COST), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(pc.DIRECT_MATERIAL), 0) AS direct_material, COALESCE(SUM(pc.DIRECT_LABOR), 0) AS direct_labor, COALESCE(SUM(pc.MANUFACTURING_OVERHEAD), 0) AS manufacturing_overhead, COALESCE(AVG(pc.UNIT_COST), 0) AS avg_unit_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PRODUCT_ID) AS product_count FROM T_PRODUCT_COST pc WHERE pc.IS_DELETED = 0 AND pc.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND pc.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} GROUP BY pc.COSTING_PERIOD ORDER BY pc.COSTING_PERIOD ASC

SELECT pc.COSTING_ID AS costing_id, pc.PRODUCT_ID AS product_id, pc.PRODUCT_CODE AS product_code, pc.PRODUCT_NAME AS product_name, pc.COSTING_PERIOD AS costing_period, pc.COSTING_METHOD AS costing_method, pc.DIRECT_MATERIAL AS direct_material, pc.DIRECT_LABOR AS direct_labor, pc.MANUFACTURING_OVERHEAD AS manufacturing_overhead, pc.TOTAL_COST AS total_cost, pc.UNIT_COST AS unit_cost, pc.PRODUCTION_QUANTITY AS production_quantity, pc.COSTING_STATUS AS costing_status, pc.BOOK_ID AS book_id, pc.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, pc.VERSION AS version, pc.CREATE_TIME AS create_time, pc.UPDATE_TIME AS update_time FROM T_PRODUCT_COST pc WHERE pc.COSTING_ID = #{costingId} AND pc.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT pi.PRODUCT_ID AS product_id, pi.PRODUCT_CODE AS product_code, pi.PRODUCT_NAME AS product_name, pi.PRODUCT_TYPE AS product_type, pi.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME AS product_type_name, pi.SPECIFICATION AS specification, pi.UNIT AS unit, pi.STANDARD_COST AS standard_cost, pi.CURRENT_STOCK AS current_stock, pi.IS_ENABLED AS is_enabled, pi.CREATE_TIME AS create_time, pi.UPDATE_TIME AS update_time FROM T_PRODUCT_INFO pi WHERE pi.IS_DELETED = 0 AND pi.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND pi.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId}
AND pi.PRODUCT_CODE LIKE '%' || #{param.productCode} || '%'
AND pi.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{param.productName} || '%'
AND pi.PRODUCT_TYPE = #{param.productType} ORDER BY pi.PRODUCT_ID ASC

SELECT r.ALERT_ID AS alert_id, r.ALERT_TIME AS alert_time, r.PRODUCT_ID AS product_id, r.PRODUCT_NAME AS product_name, r.ALERT_TYPE AS alert_type, r.ALERT_LEVEL AS alert_level, r.ALERT_CONTENT AS alert_content, r.HANDLE_STATUS AS handle_status, r.CREATE_TIME AS create_time FROM T_COST_ALERT_RECORD r WHERE r.IS_DELETED = 0 AND r.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND r.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} ORDER BY r.ALERT_TIME DESC

SELECT r.RULE_ID AS rule_id, r.RULE_NAME AS rule_name, r.ALERT_TYPE AS alert_type, r.ALERT_CONDITION AS alert_condition, r.THRESHOLD AS threshold, r.IS_ENABLED AS is_enabled, r.CREATE_TIME AS create_time FROM T_COST_ALERT_RULE r WHERE r.IS_DELETED = 0 AND r.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND r.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} ORDER BY r.RULE_ID ASC

SELECT m.MEASURE_ID AS measure_id, m.MEASURE_NAME AS measure_name, m.MEASURE_TYPE AS measure_type, m.APPLICABLE_PRODUCTS AS applicable_products, m.EXPECTED_EFFECT AS expected_effect, m.IMPLEMENT_STATUS AS implement_status, m.CREATE_TIME AS create_time FROM T_COST_CONTROL_MEASURE m WHERE m.IS_DELETED = 0 AND m.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND m.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} ORDER BY m.MEASURE_ID DESC

SELECT e.EXCEPTION_ID AS exception_id, e.EXCEPTION_TIME AS exception_time, e.PRODUCT_ID AS product_id, e.PRODUCT_NAME AS product_name, e.EXCEPTION_TYPE AS exception_type, e.EXCEPTION_AMOUNT AS exception_amount, e.EXCEPTION_REASON AS exception_reason, e.HANDLE_STATUS AS handle_status, e.CREATE_TIME AS create_time FROM T_COST_EXCEPTION e WHERE e.IS_DELETED = 0 AND e.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND e.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId} ORDER BY e.EXCEPTION_TIME DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) AS total_budget, COALESCE(SUM(b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS actual_cost, COALESCE(SUM(b.VARIANCE_AMOUNT), 0) AS variance, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT) * 100.0 / SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT), 2) END AS execution_rate, CASE WHEN SUM(b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT) <= SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT) THEN '优秀' WHEN SUM(b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT) <= SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 1.05 THEN '良好' WHEN SUM(b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT) <= SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT) * 1.10 THEN '一般' ELSE '需改进' END AS overall_rating, SUM(CASE WHEN b.BUDGET_STATUS = 'OVER_BUDGET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exceed_count, CASE WHEN SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT - b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(SUM(b.BUDGET_AMOUNT - b.ACTUAL_AMOUNT), 0) END AS saving_amount, '建议加强超预算项目的成本控制，保持当前节约项目的优化措施。' AS suggestion FROM T_BUDGET_EXECUTION b WHERE b.IS_DELETED = 0 AND b.BOOK_ID = #{param.bookId} AND b.TENANT_ID = #{param.tenantId}
AND b.BUDGET_PERIOD = #{param.costingPeriod}
